items.title: Flags SDK now works on Vercel without FLAGS_SECRET
items.summary: With , projects on Vercel can use  and precompute without . That cuts out a setup step for new projects and removes the need to keep a shared secret in sync across microfrontends. flags@4.5.0Flags ExplorerFLAGS_SECRETVercel signs Flags Explorer discovery requests and overrides, and the SDK encrypts flag values shown in the Vercel Toolbar with Vercel’s public key.Existing projects keep using  while the environment variable is set or the secret is passed in code. Upgrading alone doesn't switch them to Vercel-managed keys. To use Vercel-managed keys for these features, remove the environment variable and any code that passes the secret explicitly. For local development, run .FLAGS_SECRETvercel env pullPrecomputed codes created without a secret work only in the deployment that created them. Precompute without a secret requires Vercel system environment variables, which are enabled by default. Prebuilt deployments and codes that must work across deployments still need a secret; use  if only precompute needs one. If you use a build cache, see the  for the required configuration.FLAGS_PRECOMPUTE_SECRETprecompute documentationLearn more in the .Flags SDK documentationRead more
